senses.gloss: (b. h.; Pealal of יפה)to be beautiful, distinguished.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:5">Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ</cite> top <he>יָפְיָפִיתָ מבני אדם</he> (<cite ref="Psalms 45:3">Ps. XLV, 3</cite>, applied to Aquila, the translator of the Bible into Greek; cmp. <cite ref="J00505">preced.</cite>) thou art distinguished among the sons of man.
